reviews.title: Dec 2025 / Jan 2026 Update
reviews.text:
One of the worst updates for a phone from the users POV. Thank god they added the search bar back to the top of the app. 

When you search a wine, the small vintage blocks are gone. Bring those back. Also, when you click into a wine, you’re now given “Popular Vintages”. Who asked for this?! This appeals to a much smaller audience than, say, “Recent Vintages”. The UI for vintages was so much better before, please revert back…please.

reviews.title: So slow to use
reviews.text:
I have used CT since 2011. I keep ~5k bottles.  I have always supported the app, but they ask for $$$ that varies greatly with # of bottles. Storage is cheap. Processing is expensive. I don’t use the AI function because I have never gotten anything valuable from a prompt.  The prices go up too fast for the number of bottles. 

The new app is still harder to use than the old one. For example, if I have an active filter going (like Bordeaux with a certain price and vintage) and then my wife wants a Skipstone, so I want to search for her.  Then I have to clear the filter which takes a few clicks. And then I’ve lost that filter. 

1.  Let us save the filters so we can get to active filters we use often
2.  Just give me a quick search of my cellar without having to clear my filters for viewing my cellar. 

I keep trying the new app and then go back to the old one.
